description: 开局全牵制陷阱——Qe2牵制黑王，Nd6绝杀
explanation_en: This is a trap from a tournament game. White's queen on e2 creates an absolute pin against the black king, with the knight on e4 as the hidden pinning piece. Black fails to notice the threat and allows the knight to deliver a double-check mate on d6.

intro.popup: 💡 开局陷阱！白方如何利用e线全牵制，仅6步将死黑王？注意白后Qe2的牵制威胁。
intro.popup_en: 💡 An opening trap! How can White use an absolute pin on the e-file to checkmate Black in just six moves? Watch for the pin threat created by Qe2.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qe2对准e8黑王，Ne4是隐藏的牵制棋子。黑Nd7??自堵d7退路，Nd6++双将绝杀！牵制让黑王无路可逃。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qe2 lines up with the black king on e8, while the knight on e4 is the hidden pinning piece. Nd7?? blocks the king's escape square, allowing Nd6# with double check. The pin leaves the king with nowhere to go.

moves.popup_en: White advances the e-pawn to claim the center.

moves.popup: 黑兵c6，卡罗-坎防御——准备d5争夺中心。
moves.popup_en: Black plays c6, entering the Caro-Kann Defense and preparing ...d5 to challenge the center.
White develops the knight to f3 and attacks d4.
Black advances the d-pawn to challenge White's center.
White develops the knight to c3, reinforcing e4 and maintaining the center.

moves.popup: 黑兵dxe4，吃掉e4——白马必须重新夺回。
moves.popup_en: Black's d-pawn captures on e4. White must recapture the pawn.

moves.popup: 白马Nc3xe4！马来到e4，正对e线——关键位置！
moves.popup_en: White's c3-knight recaptures on e4, landing on the key e-file.

moves.popup: 黑马Nf6！攻击Ne4，看似合理——但白方有绝妙伏招！
moves.popup_en: Black develops the knight to f6, attacking the knight on e4. It looks natural, but White has a clever trap.

moves.popup: 白后Qe2！关键着法——后对准e线直指黑王e8！Ne4是【牵制棋子】：若Ne4移开，Qe2直接将军。黑马Nf6被全牵制，一动则Nd6绝杀！
moves.popup_en: White plays Qe2! The queen targets the black king on e8 along the e-file. The knight on e4 is the pinning piece: if it moves, Qe2 gives check. Black's knight on f6 is absolutely pinned; moving it allows Nd6#.

moves.popup: 黑马Nd7??——致命失误！马从f6移走，且d7正是黑王的唯一退路，现在被自己的马堵死！
moves.popup_en: Nd7?? is a fatal blunder. The knight leaves f6 and blocks d7, the black king's only escape square.

moves.popup: Nd6## 绝杀！白马跳d6——既将军（马攻e8），又闪出e线让白后将军！双将，黑王无处可逃：d8有黑后，d7被黑马堵死，f8有黑象，e7被白后控制。
moves.popup_en: Nd6# is checkmate! The knight checks the king on e8 and uncovers the queen's attack along the e-file, delivering double check. The king has no escape: d8 is occupied by Black's queen, d7 is blocked by Black's knight, f8 is covered by Black's bishop, and e7 is controlled by White's queen.
